name: How long will I be without a kitchen or bathroom during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long will I be without a kitchen or bathroom during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration you'll be without a functional kitchen or bathroom during a remodel varies greatly by project scope. For a basic kitchen refresh, you might be without it for 2-4 weeks. A full gut remodel, involving new layouts and extensive changes, could mean 6-10 weeks or more without a usable kitchen. Similarly, a bathroom remodel can range from 1-2 weeks for minor updates to 3-5 weeks for a complete overhaul. Your contractor can provide a more precise estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: You could be without a kitchen for 2-10 weeks, and a bathroom for 1-5 weeks, depending on the remodel's scope and complexity.
